# ABot-M0 × Qwen3.5-4B · LIBERO-plus

[Home](../../../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../../README.md) · [All experiments](../../README.md)

The LIBERO `steps_40000` policy is evaluated **without additional training**. There are 10,030 unique perturbation variants, each evaluated once. The overall episode micro-average is **8,027/10,030 = 80.03%**. Suite and category counts differ; averaging their percentages would produce a different metric.

Repeated video records are grouped by `(suite, task_id)`. The latest-mtime record is selected for 101 duplicate keys, with all alternatives retained. Three keys have conflicting verdicts; alternative selections bound the score at **80.01%–80.04%**.
